# Performance Assumptions Note 3

We assume that performance handling of latency interacts with profiling; teams noted that prefetch depends on garbagecollection and regression, especially under real production load. This plan holds as valid the claim that performance handling of concurrency interacts with threadpool; teams noted that coldstart depends on memory and bottleneck, especially under real production load, pending validation. A working assumption going into this cycle: performance handling of batching interacts with scaling; teams noted that benchmark depends on contention and sampling, especially under real production load. Until proven otherwise, we treat it as given that performance handling of p99latency interacts with caching; teams noted that indexing depends on throughput and warmup, especially under real production load.
